Name:
Ant Clemons - T-Shirt [V2]
(feat. Chance the Rapper)
Notes:
OG Filename: 01 T Shirt Ant Clemons Chance The Rapper
Ant Clemons track very likely recorded in 2018 or 2019, due to the fact Chance and Ant were working together a lot during this time during sessions for GAJ18. Version without Chance leaked sometime in 2020, then later, on November 9th, it leaked in full alongside 55 other Ant Clemons songs. Unfortunately these have both been lost as the Dbree links are now broken. Contains a feature verse from Chance and background vocals from Ty Dolla $ign. Chance's vocals have been described as unmixed based on their audio quality and possibly contain some mumble. New snippet leaked June 4th, 2023. Full lyrics have been transcribed on Genius, so it's likely still in circulation. One of the most perplexing cases of unarchived leaks.
